summary: Pre-PR code-review skill gate run at medium effort over the diff: 1 finding, found in my own change and fixed in this branch before pushing. tests/test_config_loading.py docstring: the note I added claimed required-checks fallback behaviour was 'NOT tested here -- all of it' lives in the derivation file, and the derivation file claimed to own 'ALL' of it. Both were false: DoctorReadsPolicyThroughConfigTests in test_config_loading.py still asserts the four defaults for absent and for empty required_checks, via doctor's branch_protection finding. Left uncorrected, a maintainer changing the fallback rule would have re-run only the derivation file on the docstring's word and been broken in CI by two tests the note told them to ignore. FIXED: both docstrings now state the real boundary -- direct helper coverage in the derivation file, doctor's end-to-end consumption in test_config_loading.py, and that a change to the rule must be re-run against both. Those doctor tests were deliberately NOT moved: they test doctor's reading of the values, not the helper in isolation, so test_config_loading.py is their correct home.
